description: 3-Month Treasury Bill Secondary Market Rate, Discount Basis (DGS3MO) -- a short-term Treasury constant-maturity yield proxy. Per Directive #9's D9-C spec: do not describe this as a full option discount curve.
missing_value_representation: Empty string in the CSV value column (FRED's raw graph-CSV endpoint returns '.' for non-observation days; this snapshot's acquisition step wrote those as empty CSV fields, not the literal '.' character -- corrected here after an earlier draft of this manifest's provenance doc incorrectly described the raw '.' marker as what's actually in this file). Non-observation days (weekends, market holidays, and FRED publication gaps) are PRESERVED AS ROWS with an empty value, not dropped, so the absence is visible in the artifact rather than silently interpolated or removed.
acquisition_provenance: Acquired 2026-09-17 by an agent session with unrestricted network egress (this session's own egress proxy returns an organization-policy 403 for fred.stlouisfed.org, recorded as a deliberate policy denial, not transient) using scripts/acquire_fred_macro_daily.py, unmodified. Raw CSV kept local and gitignored under data/raw/ (not committed to this public repo) -- redistribution rights for FRED-sourced series have not been separately checked. Reproduce with: python scripts/acquire_fred_macro_daily.py --dataset-id fred_dgs3mo_daily_2015_2025_v1 --series DGS3MO
notes: Authoritative D9-C dataset per Directive #9's exact spec ID. Repackaged 2026-09-17 from a provisional combined snapshot (fred_macro_daily_2015_2025_v1, which held both DGS3MO and VIXCLS together under a non-spec dataset ID) into this series' own authoritative dataset_id. No values changed -- same bytes, same acquisition event, corrected packaging and documentation only.
